title: Seagrove Bungalow 110 - One Ten Again | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Cottage! * Just 350 yards to Seagrove Beach!* Two Pools, a Hot tub, Walking Bridges, and Fishable Lake* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef* Under 2 miles to Seaside! Enjoy activities like free outdoor movies!* 4 Bikes Included
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Cottage! * Just 350 yards to Seagrove Beach!* Two Pools, a Hot tub, Walking Bridges, and Fishable Lake* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef* Under 2 miles to Seaside! Enjoy activities like free outdoor movies!* 4 Bikes Included * Walk to Cafe 30A, Angelina's Italian, or Donut Hut!* Nearby Greenway Station - NEW Summer 2023!* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to One Ten Again, a 2-bedroom 2.5-bathroom. It is just a short 350 yards from the beautiful white sand beaches. With a king in the master and twin bunks and a queen bed in the guest room on the second floor, this home sleeps 6 comfortably! Prepare anything from your morning coffee to a full-course dinner in the well-equipped kitchen and lots of seats for your guests around the table or bar. If you need to wash a load or two of clothes, there is a stacked washer and dryer. Enjoy sitting on your private balcony or your porch watching the sunsets. Come escape to the adorable One Ten Again!**This property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **Bungalows at Seagrove is a planned bungalow community of 56 individual 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath homes in Seagrove Beach, less than 2 miles east of Seaside, on Highway 30-A. It is within walking distance to bike, golf cart, kayak rentals, and stores to purchase beach essentials. If you forgot or need something it is a 4-minute walk to Tom Thumb Convenience Store. You can also walk to Goat feathers Seafood Market for their fresh seafood, steamed shrimp, smoked tuna dip, and more. This well-appointed planned community is within walking distance of the beach and includes 2 pools, a hot tub, masterfully landscaped grounds with an adjoining lake, abundant parking spaces, and sidewalks, with numerous wooden walk bridges.The Bed Setup: Second Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest bedroom: Queen Bed and Twin/Twin Bunk BedsArea Attractions:One Ten Again is centrally located on 30A with only a short bike ride to the excellent shopping and dining options of Seaside! If you prefer a stroll, then Café 30A is only minutes away and constantly ranked as one of the best restaurants on 30A. Angelina's is also within walking distance for pasta or pizza. Walk to The Donut Hut for morning donuts or breakfast sandwiches. The Big Chill at Prominence, around 3 miles east, is a great place to take kids, watch an outdoor movie, listen to music, or eat at one of the half-a-dozen small places.Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis - you'll find it all right here.Greenway station is 30A's newest destination for gathering, shopping, and dining in Seagrove Beach. Greenway Station features known retailers Wild Olives Tapas and Wine Bar, Pecan Jack's Ice Cream, Coast Hippie, and YOLO Board + Bike, plus introduces Local Cantina Mexican Restaurant, Souper Jenny Coffee Roasters, Canopy Road Café, and more.This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
